technical.reason: Plausible explicitly untested model: buyer/trigger, bounded offer, test price, switching experiment and named recruitment routes. Readiness/qualification/exclusion gates keep scope honest.
risks: The fixed N=8 catalog may not inform a real buying decision.
Named firms are experts/competitors, seven invitation slots are unfilled and secondary forum access is unverified.
Free scripts may suffice; no measured switching benefit, buyer budget or service effort.
Manual assisted delivery is distinct from unfinished app automation.
technical.wording: We propose testing a US$250 assisted evaluation with qualified engineers; no customer or price is validated yet.

customer.reason: The bounded purchase and testable switching reason constitute a coherent untested model. Specific channels and honest price/economics improve actionability without implying interested buyers.
risks: Fit between the exact supported sample and a buyer's actual job remains the weakest assumption.
Expert access is not a sales channel yet; first-ten queue is not ten identified prospects.
Free-session enthusiasm is not purchase intent, delivery cost or willingness to pay.
A successful service experiment would not by itself validate the software business.
customer.wording: Retain hypothesis, plan, would test and no validated customers or price.

pitch-ai.reason: A plausible untested model now identifies operator/budget-owner hypothesis, bounded deliverable, honest test price, alternatives, falsification and source-backed places to recruit.
risks: Specific places do not prove current demand for this narrow offer.
Engineering-service firms are expert/referral candidates, not budget owners looking for this offer.
Manual assistance cannot be narrated as a complete automated receipt or recurring software business.
No outcome proves experienced engineers would pay rather than use existing scripts.
pitch-ai.wording: Replace the engineering lead would fund an evaluation with we would test the offer with the engineering lead who controls evaluation spend.

threshold_meaning: plausible untested model; not demand or approved pricing
